name: Sharp Eye
summary: Advantage on a Search or Study action's check, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest; a failed check keeps the use.

benefits.name: Keen Scrutiny
benefits.summary: PB times per Long Rest, Advantage on a Search or Study action's check; a failure doesn't spend the use.
benefits.text: Taking the Search or Study action, you can roll its ability check with Advantage. Uses: your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest, and a check that still fails gives the use back.
